independent_A0.setup: All three layers are placed on common vertex universe U=S_sigma union C_sigma, with non-layer survivor vertices isolated. I_sigma is the union of the three edge sets.
lower_bound: Take an induced crossing matching M in one layer i.
All survivor endpoints of M lie in R_i.
Every edge belonging to another layer j!=i has survivor endpoint in R_j, hence cannot be an edge between two endpoints of M.
Therefore M remains induced in I_sigma.
upper_bound: Take an induced crossing matching M in I_sigma.
Partition M by the unique layer of each survivor endpoint: M=M1 disjoint_union M2 disjoint_union M3.
Every M_i is an induced crossing matching in layer i; any layer-i chord would also be an I_sigma chord.
independent_A0.decomposition_conclusion: Taking the maximum over cuts of one fixed decomposition T gives COMMON_LAYER_MIM(T)<=mim_{I_sigma}(T)<=3 COMMON_LAYER_MIM(T).

independent_D1.imported_fact: If cut mim-width is at most w, every subset X on one side has a subset representative R of size at most w with the same external neighborhood.
independent_D1.count_one_set: At most sum_{j=0}^w binom(n,j) <= n^{O(w)} 1-neighborhood classes.
independent_D1.joint_objects: For 3 auxiliary stable layers and 4 actual colors, at most 12 processed survivor subsets are tracked.
independent_D1.joint_count: At most (sum_{j=0}^w binom(n,j))^12 = n^{O(12w)} joint d=1 signatures per coarse class.
independent_D1.component_mask: For every external component C and color c, the signature determines whether C sees at least one processed neighbor of color c, hence determines the survivor-side forbidden-color mask.
independent_D1.ceiling: No source-sufficiency or reconstruction conclusion is inferred.
